description: This file defines classes representing nodes within an HTML DOM tree, including element nodes (TagNode), text nodes (TextNode), the body element (BodyNode), visible object nodes (VisibleTagNode), and a generic no-op node (DummyNode). It includes methods for tree manipulation, comparison, and HTML element representation, indicating it's a source file for HTML DOM handling and diffing.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Base class for elements in the DOM tree, providing parent-child relationships and common navigation methods.

classes.name: TagNode
classes.description: Represents an HTML tag that can contain child nodes, manages attributes, children, and provides methods for tree modifications and comparison.

classes.name: TextNode
classes.description: Represents a piece of text in the HTML document, with support for modifications and comparison.

classes.name: WhiteSpaceNode
classes.description: A specialized TextNode representing whitespace, can clone modifications from other text nodes.

classes.name: BodyNode
classes.description: Represents the root <body> element of an HTML document, extending TagNode.

classes.name: VisibleTagNode
classes.description: Represents a visible object element, such as an image, with specific comparison logic.

classes.name: DummyNode
classes.description: A no-operation node, acts as a placeholder.

methods.name: getParentTree
methods.description: Returns the chain of parent nodes up to the root.

methods.name: getLastCommonParent
methods.description: Finds the last common parent node between this node and another.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent node.

methods.name: inPre
methods.description: Checks if the node is within a <pre> HTML element.

methods.name: addChildAbsolute
methods.description: Inserts a child node at a specific index.

methods.name: getIndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a child node.

methods.name: getNbChildren
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: getMinimalDeletedSet
methods.description: Returns minimal set of nodes marked for deletion.

methods.name: splitUntil
methods.description: Splits nodes up to a certain parent node along a specified split point.

methods.name: copyTree
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the node and its descendants.

methods.name: getMatchRatio
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two TagNodes.

methods.name: expandWhiteSpace
methods.description: Expands whitespace nodes within a TagNode.

methods.name: getLeftMostChild
methods.description: Returns the leftmost descendant node.

methods.name: getRightMostChild
methods.description: Returns the rightmost descendant node.

methods.name: isPre
methods.description: Checks if the node is a <pre> element.

methods.name: toDiffLine
methods.description: Converts a TagNode to its diff representation.
